title: clinopodium graveolens
intro: Clinopodium graveolens, commonly known as Calamian sea lavender, is a plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Clinopodium graveolens include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
